name: 17403 · York, PA
findings: ZIP 17403 (York) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17403 (York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17403 (York) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 77 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
